items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] No, Leo. Leah. [INTERVIEWEE] No brother. Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, you see, you're counting Dutch, but what about the ones before Dutch? You had my sister, then a brother Stanley, then me, and my brother Maurice, then Dutch, then Leo. I mean, she's the youngest, Dutch?
